prompts: Remember the little archery games of the Windows 95 days? We want the first level of one, our own, in {WS}/game/index.html, a single file. An archer you aim with the mouse, pulling the bow back for power, balloons to pop, a score on screen, a way to start and a way to lose. How it looks, plays and sounds is your call, and that is what we care about most: a minute of play should be fun, and every shot and hit should feel and sound good. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts, and by playing it.
answers:
**[goal]** A single-file Win95-style archery balloon game in `./game/index.html`.

**[action]** Wrote the whole game (canvas, WebAudio SFX, Google Fonts) and played it live in the browser.

**[result]** Verified working:
- Title screen renders with pixel fonts ("BALLOON POP '95", "CLICK TO START").
- Click starts the game; HUD shows SCORE / GOAL 15 / LIVES (3 hearts).
- Balloons spawn from the right and drift left with wobble.
- Archer aims at the cursor; holding the mouse draws the bow with a color-shifting power bar; release fires an arrow with a trail and slight gravity.
- A pop registered: score went 0 → 1 with particle burst and floating "+1".
- No build step; only external dependency is Google Fonts (Press Start 2P, VT323), which loaded.

**[assumptions]** Win95 feel = pixel font + flat vector scene + retro square-wave SFX. Win = reach 15 points; lose = 3 balloons escape off-screen. Pull-and-release for power, as briefed.

**[evidence]** Screenshots from the live session show the title, the HUD, the drawn bow with power bar, the arrow in flight, and SCORE 1 after a hit.

**[cleanup]** Browser tabs closed (the game tab auto-closed on navigation end; the remaining about:blank tab was already gone).

**[next]** Open `game/index.html` in any browser to play.
